fact: On 18 May 2022 the National Statistics Council gave unregistered firms 72 hours to register in the first business census or face fines under articles 7.1 and 36.1 of Law 3/2020 of 16 October.
title: Consejo Nacional de Estadísticas: «aquellas empresas que no se hayan empadronado hasta ahora, tienen 72 horas; o serán sancionadas»
